body:
Creating Organization Specific Training using HCP's Blank Modules

The Monthly Refresher Training for June covered Website Compliance Information Resources and all participants received a free Blank Module. The Blank Modules can be used to develop and track organization specific training. On July 9 th at 1pm Eastern Time we will discuss how to use a blank module to create organization specific training. Your host will include training on: adding slides, changing order of slides, creating quizzes and tests as well as importing PowerPoint presentation slides, uploading videos and other media into self developed training. Again, all participants will receive a code to request a free blank module.
